description: This data set is one of the few fully open operational records of a commercial wind farm. It was released by the owner, Cubico Sustainable Investments, with Charlie Plumley and Roberta Takeuchi as creators, so that researchers can work with real turbine data. It covers the six Senvion MM92 turbines at Kelmarsh wind farm in the United Kingdom. Contents are a KMZ file of the site, static turbine data with coordinates, rated power, rotor diameter and hub height, 10-minute SCADA signals and event logs grouped by year from 2016 to the end of 2024, extracted from the secondary SCADA system (Greenbyte), a mapping from primary SCADA names to CSV column names, and substation or PMU meter data and fiscal grid meter data where available. Coverage is one site. Files are CSV in yearly ZIP archives, about 3.8 GB in the August 2025 version, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: not all signals are available for the whole period, and data are provided as is. Uses include wind turbine performance and power curve analysis, fault and anomaly detection, and validating wind farm models. Related records: data-penmanshiel-wind-farm-scada is the companion release from the same owner.
